results.name: CBRE Group Inc.
results.description: CBRE Group Inc. (formerly CB Richard Ellis Group Inc.) is a holding company that conducts all of its operations through its subsidiaries. The Company is a commercial real estate services and investment company. The company was incorporated on February 20th 2001 as a subsidiary of Blum Capital Partners LP, a private equity firm. Upon the completion of the initial public offering of the company on June 10th 2004, Blum Capital Partners LP only owns 27% of the company's stocks.
